reviewer: independent native and actual-font visual review by expand_repertoire
method: Actual temporary TTFs built from current native-derived source JSON using uniform proportional centerline normalization738 and common pens30/43. Inspect FreeType2048ppem rasters against unchanged native PNG and every available labeled Unicode chart specimen. Counts supplement explicit course/mark/attachment review; counts alone are not acceptance.
limitations: Visual structural comparison, not specialist paleographic certification or historical stroke-order verification.
Only pen30 Regular and pen43 SemiBold are directly inspected here; no uninspected weights are certified.
